# `company.inventory_transfer_revisions`

Immutable revisions of inventory transfers.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this immutable revision. |
| `transfer_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with transfer_id + revision_number | — | inventory_transfers.id | Transfer this revision belongs to. |
| `revision_number` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with transfer_id + revision_number | — | — | Revision of the transfer, from 1; the highest is current. |
| `operation` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | post, update or void. |
| `date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Date the stock left and arrived, YYYY-MM-DD. |
| `count_position` | VARCHAR(8) | no | — | — | — | — | before or after the counts of its sites on its date. |
| `from_site_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | inventory_sites.id | Site the stock left. |
| `to_site_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | inventory_sites.id | Site the stock arrived at; the same site when moving between its bins. |
| `memo` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Memo as entered; null when blank. |
| `reason` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | Why this revision was written, as the caller gave it. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this revision was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this revision. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this revision. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this revision. |
